Description: Operators can read HMI/PLC state in control & supervisory zones.
Target Predicates: subject.role eq operator; action.id eq read

Description: Engineers can read/write field..supervisory assets outside emergencies.
Safety interlocks cannot be overridden while safety_state=normal.
Target Predicates: action.id eq override_interlock; resource.criticality eq safety

Description: Cleared on-site engineers may override a safety interlock during maintenance.
Target Predicates: subject.role eq engineer; action.id eq override_interlock; resource.criticality eq safety
Condition Predicates: environment.safety_state eq maintenance; subject.clearance_level gte 4; subject.location eq onsite

Description: Vendors are denied access to level-0 field-zone devices.
Vendors may read the historian during normal production.
Target Predicates: subject.role eq vendor; action.id eq read; resource.type eq historian
